limits: Shared host, no CPU isolation, no per-pass sampler, no proven residency or continuous affinity. Admission reads loadavg/CPU PSI BEFORE each whole block; records all waits, no within-block exclusion or normalization. A passing admission does not prove low per-core load during every pass. Producer unpinned, reciprocal arms not independent replicates. Boundary snapshots can alter warm state. Same selected executable and unchanged tput.py fastest of three DA1 passes 154x39. No new Ghostty metric in this experiment.
